hypothesis: Independent geometric motion and translation-prior targets can prevent native feature-history feedback from sustaining the KITTI 01 collapse.
method_identity: Repository hybrid InTEn + independent Zoo KISS-ICP initializer, not paper InTEn and not official upstream KISS-ICP.
selection: Hypothesis selected from committed independent-onset study on 01; all KITTI is development. Baseline range/elevation selected on 07/00; mapped prior and weak ratio 0.03 / PCA settings inherited unchanged from inten_facade_pca. Geometric settings copied from upstream-mechanics defaults, no sweep.
input: Raw .bin XYZI hashes must equal archived facade study; native float arithmetic elevation 0.17 degrees, finite XYZI, strict 1 < r < 120. No GT in native runner. Continuous states from frame zero. No deskew.
transport: One sequence at a time, bounded batches using the existing official fetch script. Each verified scan is sent to a persistent native process then removed; batches never reset estimator state. Retain per-scan hash, order, native outputs and all command exits.
controls: Run current baseline and candidate in the same executable on every input. Compare baseline unanchored poses to every archived full-precision facade trace (max matrix error <= 1e-8); mismatch invalidates comparison and must be diagnosed without retuning.
metrics: Official KITTI 100-800 m RTE and ATE for every full sequence; same external evaluator. Also retain complete local step diagnostics and original 01 adverse cases (202,215,420).
prospective_retention_gate: All controls valid and all sequences complete; candidate geometric-mean RTE lower than baseline, and no sequence RTE above max(1.10*baseline, baseline+0.05 percentage points). This is an experimental retention gate, not a paper/SOTA claim. Record every negative regardless of gate.
stopping_rule: One fixed candidate. No changed constants after reading any new result. If it fails, retain the failure and do not begin another parameter sweep. Historical scores and paper-variant eligibility remain unchanged.
